tldr: The Sun in Scorpio: identity built through depth, honesty, and transformation.
body: With the Sun in Scorpio, the core self strengthens when you stop skimming the surface and face what is real. You are here to develop power through truth, trust, and emotional courage.
gift: Intensity, resilience, loyalty, psychological insight, and the ability to transform through crisis.
challenge: Control, secrecy, suspicion, and holding pain until it becomes armor.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
